title: Tranquillized but at risk: the conservation cost of rhino capture
content: Sedation is an essential tool in the fight to save white rhinos (Ceratotherium simum ssp. Simum), but it may come with unintended risks. Conservationists rely on powerful tranquillisers to safely immobilize these vulnerable animals—but new research by an international team of researchers (Boesch et al., 2025) reveals that one commonly used drug, etorphine, may come with serious physiological side effects.
